answer_2.quote: We report dataset-specific accuracy on each benchmark to assess in-domain performance and out-of-domain generalization. In particular, we use micro-average accuracy for OlympiadBench similar to , and Exact Match (EM) for all other datasets.

answer_3.quote: We prompt Gemini for similarity. We construct a natural-language prompt comparing the generated plan to the gold plan and send it to Gemini-2.0-Flash, asking it to rate plan similarity on a 0-1 scale.
